layouts.label: Open scene
layouts.description: One known wall and one obstacle omitted from the planning map.

layouts.label: Cluttered scene
layouts.description: Twelve varied-height boxes, pillars, a sphere and held-out obstacles create more occlusion and local detours.

layouts.label: Narrow passage
layouts.description: Tall corridor walls and alternating barriers restrict the route and occlude two held-out obstacles.

interpretation: Repeated sensor-noise trials within three pre-existing deterministic layouts; confidence intervals describe stochastic outcomes conditional on each layout and this controller, not population-level real-world reliability.
